objective: Implement lines(chunks) returning text lines from arbitrary string chunks. LF delimits a line, remove one CR immediately preceding LF. Preserve empty lines. Emit final unterminated nonempty buffer unchanged, including any trailing CR. No extra line for a final LF. Export lines through api.py. Preserve api.health() returning {"status":"ok","version":1}. Standard library only.
defect_explanation: Chunk boundaries become unintended line boundaries.
executable_assertions:
from api import lines, health
assert health()=={"status":"ok","version":1}
assert lines(['ab','c\r','\n\n','tail\r'])==['abc','','tail\r']
assert lines([])==[]
assert lines(['a\n'])==['a']
assert lines(['','\n','','\n'])==['','']
assert lines(['a\r\rb\n'])==['a\r\rb']
assert lines(['a\r\r\n'])==['a\r']
